phase: algorithm and visual review ONLY; account backtests forbidden
hypothesis: Price swings have different structural roles. A pullback pivot earns promotion only after supporting a break of its reference extreme. Volume explains the relation of successive legs instead of speeding pivot confirmation.
history: All development history previously seen. Two-prefix manual notes saved before new output. Not out-of-sample or genuinely blind.

v0.parser: price-only same sqrt5 * lagged63 logreturn RMS at extreme; volume only common valid-observation eligibility
v0.structure: neutral: new confirmed pivot plus last2highs and last2lows both rising => up, both falling => down. Active boundary breaks -> neutral; no same-row reestablishment. Pullback pivot promotes only after current close exceeds reference previous confirmed extreme. Direction not changed by volume. At establishment current close must still be strictly inside proposed boundary; pre-run invariant clarification, not a post-output revision.
v0.volume: last two confirmed legs (start,end]; E mean(V/prior21 median); S abs(log endpoint displacement)/valid n; ratios new/old compared with natural1; no probabilities. Support/opposition labels conditional on structural direction; mixed ratios contested. No developing leg consumption in v0; known stale-phase risk.
v0.comparators: old saved price/volume event structure; price-only phase from S; Bollinger20 SMA/std0 percent_b and relative bandwidth; independent 4 disjoint63obs simple returns weighted .4,.2,.2,.2 (O’Neil-inspired, not proprietary replica) ranked only same-date same saved group, average ties, NaN unranked.
v0.freedoms: 21/63 and sqrt5 inherited;20 from Bollinger descriptive default;252 ranking only, never structural warmup requirement. No grid search.

review: 15 fixed cases and both saved raw checkpoints
if common contradiction warrants, one mechanism revision plus all15 review
no future-label accuracy optimization; no PnL/nAV
checks: positive volume reallocation keeps pivots and direction, can change phase
failure_cases: V turns and monotonic moves delay established structure
short shallow pullback can look fast
volume phase can lag while waiting for next pivot
stop: After v0 and at most one substantive revision: report retained/failure/uncertain mechanism. No account stage.

fixes: candidate invalidated at first close crossing its boundary before promotion
stable numeric diagnostic dtypes across prefixes; failed attempt2 retained
repair test: reorder finite positive volume only, preserving invalid-observation clock; attempt3 retained
